name: Avoid rivaroxaban with ritonavir
actions: Avoid concomitant rivaroxaban and ritonavir as directed in the rivaroxaban label.

rationale: Ritonavir inhibits both CYP3A4 and P-gp, increasing rivaroxaban exposure and bleeding risk.

explanation_template: Ritonavir can raise rivaroxaban exposure through combined CYP3A4 and P-gp inhibition. The rivaroxaban label says to avoid this combination.

references.citation: Avoid rivaroxaban with combined P-gp and strong CYP3A inhibitors such as ritonavir.
